translations.fpi.efficiencies.note: Team efficiencies are based on the point contributions of each unit to the team's scoring margin, on a per-play basis. The scale goes from 0 to 100; higher numbers are better and the average is roughly 50 for all categories. Efficiencies update daily during the season.

Ratings and projections update daily.
